title: Violet Fault Spire
description: A seven-metre violet blade growing with smaller intergrown crystals from a displaced limestone fissure; references: ref_07_violet_crater and ref_03_canyon_cliffs.

review.notes: Round 1 (new build). Good silhouette: a tall 7 m main shaft with a fan of smaller crystals and a layered limestone base whose strata and broken edges are the best stone in this PR. Defects: (1) material: same as the cluster. Uniform saturated purple with mottled light and dark polygon blotches along the whole shaft (hero.jpg, turn_245/290); no dark core, no inner bands, no directional facet light. 'Violett dominiert jede Fläche' is listed as a failure in the STYLE.md review table. (2) form_detail: the main shaft is a near-parallel column whose faces are broken into small random facets, so it reads as crumpled foil and not as a single crystal with 6 large faces. Taper it slightly, keep the prism faces flat, and add growth steps or a secondary termination. (3) defects: the long crack in closeup.jpg is a thin black painted line with no depth or glow. Model it as a real fracture with an offset and faint emission. All tips are pristine.
